## Column Page Inset Right Test

This tests the `.column-page-inset-right` class which extends to the right with an inset.

::: {.column-page-inset-right}
PAGE-INSET-RIGHT-CONTENT: This content should extend toward the right page edge with a small inset, while keeping the left edge aligned with the body column.
:::

Regular text for comparison.
